# core-v1_language_file (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) The application group for the language file
- `language` (String) The language code for the desired translation file with country code (en_US, fr_CA)

### Read-Only

- `content` (Attributes Map) The content of the language file (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content))
- `default` (Boolean) Indicates if this is the default language for this app
- `missing_locale` (Boolean) Indicates the requested locale was not found, so the default was returned
